name: Sally
message: 「Heheh, weaklings sure are fast on their feet.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's toward Finis Tower! What should we do? Chase them right away?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, pursuing them too far is dangerous. Let's wait for everyone to gather.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, our night alone together is ruined...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, are you okay? Did you get hurt anywhere?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, ah, I'm fine. Totally fine, totally fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you say so, just don't push yourself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm grateful you're worried about me, but... sigh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez... Synn-sama really is dense as a brick.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... it's better than a guy who only thinks with his crotch.」

name: Paqy
message: 「At this rate, that Academy Harem Plan is gonna stay a pipe dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not dreaming of anything like that!」
